summary: Iter-18: Sector landing improvements. Backend pytest 20/20 passed (test_vozlead_iter18.py) covering marks + mp3 audio generation for all 14 sector/country combinations, 404 for unknown slug/country, admin-only DELETE /api/admin/sector-demos (403 non-admin, 401/403 unauth). First call to /marks for cold slugs triggered real audio generation and still returned 200 with 7 marks + duration (~31s total for 14 pages → mostly cached). Frontend Playwright: Home /, /es, /cl all render sectors-section + all 7 sector-card-<slug> + sector-card-other; all images load (naturalWidth>0, no broken); landing-nav-sectores-link present; clicking sector-card-play-clinicas-dentales fires GET /api/public/sector-demo/es/clinicas-dentales.mp3, clicking sector-card-play-barberias fires second mp3 (first stops via shared player singleton). Sector page /es/barberias renders marketing-page-es/barberias, sector-hero, sector-breadcrumb, hero-title ('Recepcionista con IA para barberías y peluquerías'), sector-player + play button + time, sector-transcript, bottom sectors-section excludes barberias (6 other cards + other-card). SEO head on /es/barberias: title='Recepcionista virtual con IA para barberías y peluquerías en España | VozLeads', canonical=https://vozleads.com/es/barberias, hreflang es-ES/es-CL/x-default present, og:image=sector unsplash image, JSON-LD @graph contains Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication (EUR+CLP offers), WebPage, FAQPage, Service, AudioObject (contentUrl pointing to API), BreadcrumbList with 3 ListItems. /cl/abogados contains 'Estudio Jurídico' + 'hora' + CLP in pricing; /es/abogados contains 'Despacho' + 'cita'. Footer shows 'Sectores' links list. Mobile 390px on /es/restaurantes: no horizontal overflow (scrollW==innerW). 401 console errors are from public /auth/me probe (expected on unauth landing pages).
critical_code_review_comments: sector_demo.get_demo: per-key asyncio.Lock prevents parallel generation of same slug; _locks dict grows unbounded with ~14 keys max — acceptable.

sector_demo.build: writes Binary mp3 directly into Mongo doc (sector_demos collection). For 14 slugs × ~tens of KB this is fine, but no TTL/eviction. If dialogs change, admin must call DELETE /api/admin/sector-demos. Documented contract.
sector_demo.demo_audio: Cache-Control public,max-age=86400 — good for CDN/browser cache but note mp3 is served from backend each miss. Consider streaming or filesystem cache for scale.

Sectors.jsx: shared module-level `player` singleton correctly stops previous audio when a new card is played. On unmount useEffect pauses only ref.current, not the singleton — fine because the new mount acquires it.
Sectors.jsx: useDemo marks fetch is triggered inside onplaying, so marks only load on first play; transcript highlight starts at mark[0]=0.6s. Good UX.
head.mjs: canonical/alternates always use cfg.site domain (https://vozleads.com) which is correct for production even in preview — verified in test.
head.mjs: AudioObject.contentUrl uses `${cfg.site}/api/public/...` — if someone copies JSON-LD on preview domain Google would hit prod. For production this is correct; previews harmless.

SectorHero.intro: shows the full intro inside the hero which is good for SEO; FAQ renders further down inside page body (verified by JSON-LD FAQPage with multiple questions, UI id='preguntas' not required per spec).
